title: Isocraft
description: Isometric view + ARPG-like gameplay to minecraft
body: # Isocraft **Isocraft turns Minecraft into a stylized isometric game** a Project-Zomboid / Diablo / League-of-Legends camera with cursor aim, click-to-move, and a smart reveal system that lifts away whatever is between you and your character so you can *always* see yourself. It's **100% client-side**, works with **Sodium & Iris**, and it's a **toggle** — press one key to drop into iso, press it again to go back to vanilla. Fabric   Minecraft 1.21.11   Client-side   Singleplayer + Multiplayer ## ✨ What makes it special Isocraft isn't a texture pack or a shader — it re-frames the entire game. Press O and the camera pulls back into a cinematic isometric angle, your character starts aiming at your cursor, and the world reshapes itself so nothing ever hides you. ![Isometric View Camping](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eff5816d9172c2e952b65ab55aa6addc5aa0c5f7.jpeg) ![Elytra Travel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8ffa2c77cf9afb7a7729dd00f8f0ce089990019.jpeg) ## 🏠 The Reveal — *"only my room"* The heart of the mod. Step indoors, underground, or into a structure and the walls, ceilings and floors between the camera and **the room you're standing in** simply lift away — like a dollhouse. Everything else stays put. No X-ray, no floating geometry — just your space, opened up. - **Any shape, any renderer.** Caves, L-shaped rooms, trial chambers, towers — the reveal follows the *actual* space you're in, and it looks identical whether you run vanilla, **Sodium**, or **Iris**. - **See-through outdoors.** Trees, hills and cliffs between the camera and your character turn **transparent in a soft circle** around you, then solidify again as you move — you're never lost behind a hill or a canopy. - **Fog-of-war mood.** Everything outside your space fades toward darkness. Slide the **Exterior Brightness** control from pure black (survival-horror) to a dim fog (dungeon-crawler) to taste. - **It hears the room too.** Sounds coming from outside your space are **muffled** — a zombie two walls over is quiet until you open the door. ![Inside a Room, Dollhouse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e65343bd52c4ad82b9b1a8d539d8fe43e01d10bd.jpeg) ## 🎯 Cursor aim & ARPG movement Your character looks and aims exactly where your cursor points — in full 3D, so **bows and projectiles line up with what you're pointing at**, height and all. Movement is screen-relative (push a direction, go that way), just like an isometric action game. - **Click-to-move** *(optional)* — hold to walk where you point, Diablo-style. Toggle it on in settings. - **Ride & steer** — boats and horses steer toward your cursor. - **Swim your way** — Space rises, Shift dives, and you hold depth in between. - **Elytra** — cursor steers your heading, Space climbs, Shift dives. ## 🧱 Bridge Assist — build to the hidden side In an isometric view you can't click the faces that point *away* from the camera — exactly the sides you need to bridge outward. Isocraft fixes that **Bedrock-style**: hold a block, point just past an edge, and a **hologram** of your block appears against the hidden face. Right-click to place it — hold and drag to bridge continuously. - Previews the real orientation (stairs, slabs, logs). - The green marker only appears when the placement will actually work. - Left-click stays safe — you can't accidentally mine the block under your feet. ![Bridge Assist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c902f17794ff3c90cd4523081ecb65f7961ea4e7.jpeg) ## ⚔️ Combat & loot juice An ARPG camera deserves ARPG feedback. | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **Health & hunger orbs** | Pixel-art orb HUD in place of the vanilla bars | | **Floating damage numbers** | Pop off mobs as you hit them | | **Loot beams** | Rarity-tinted pillars of light on dropped items | | **Nameplates** | Floating health bars + names over mobs | | **Threat silhouettes** | Monsters hidden behind walls glow so they can't ambush you blind | | **Damage-direction ping** | A red tick flashes toward off-screen hits | | **Player light halo** | Keeps a readable circle of light around you at night / in caves | | **Context cursor** | The cursor tells you what a click will do — walk, mine, use, attack, or build | ![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1121fddee0d1c86dcd25c3ea5b615009cb4689c0.jpeg) ## 🛋️ Quality of life - **Bubble menus** — chests, furnaces and crafting UIs float *over the block* in the world instead of covering the screen. - **In-game settings** with **live preview** — drag a slider and watch the world react, no reloads. Press the settings key any time. - **Three one-click presets** — **Survivor** (hard black, tense), **Dungeon** (dim fog), **Cozy** (bright and warm). - **Gentle onboarding** — tiny one-time hint cards teach each system the first time it's relevant, then never again. - **Diorama Shot** — press F6 for a clean, HUD-free screenshot of your build. (That's how you make the pictures on this very page.) ![Bubble Menus and Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9ad30275d9fa493b3ffc239f083abe57ee67787.jpeg) ## 🎛️ Controls | Action | Key | |---|---| | Toggle isometric view | O | | Zoom | Mouse wheel | | Rotate camera | , / . | | Pitch up / down | Page Up / Page Down | | Settings | *(bindable)* | | Bow aim arc on/off | *(bindable)* | | Diorama screenshot | F6 | *Everything is rebindable in Options → Controls, and every feature can be toggled in the Isocraft settings screen.* ## 🧩 Compatibility - ✅ **Client-side only** — install it yourself, play on any server (vanilla or modded), nobody else needs it. - ✅ **Sodium** & **Iris** supported — the reveal matches the vanilla look on both. - ✅ Works alongside most content and QoL mods. - ⚠️ **Distant Horizons / Voxy** — not officially supported yet. - ⚠️ Requires **Fabric API**. ## 📦 Install 1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft **1.21.11**. 2. Drop **Fabric API** and **Isocraft** into your `mods` folder. 3. Launch, load a world, and press O. *(Sodium and Iris are optional — Isocraft detects them and adapts automatically.)* ## ❓ FAQ **Does it work in multiplayer?** Yes. It's purely visual/local — the server never knows. **Do I have to play in iso the whole time?** No. It's a toggle. Press O to switch views whenever you like. **Does it change gameplay or give an advantage?** No stats, no cheats — it's a camera and a UI. The reveal only shows the room you're already in; it doesn't X-ray through the world. **Known rough edges (being honest):** - A couple of block types (chests, beds, signs) show only an outline instead of a full hologram in Bridge Assist — they still place fine. - The settings screen gets a little cramped at very high GUI scales on small monitors.
